# VibeUI (full reference)

> Copy-owned React + Tailwind components. MIT. https://github.com/arjunkshah12345-hash/vibeui
> Version 0.8.0 · 178 components · generated from registry/components.json

## Setup

- Peers: clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, @phosphor-icons/react
- Tailwind v4. Import the token file AFTER `@import "tailwindcss";` (templates/vibeui.css or vibeui.tokens.css).
- Path alias `@/*` -> `src/*`. Components import `cn` from `@/lib/utils`.
- Dark mode: `dark` class on <html>. `light` / `dark` on any element pins that subtree.
- Install: `npx @agents-npm-packages/vibeui add <name...> --dir ./src/components/ui` (siblings are copied automatically).
- Toasts need <ToastProvider> once near the root.

## Conventions

- One file per component in src/components/ui/<kebab>.tsx; named exports only.
- className is merged last with cn(); remaining props spread onto the root element.
- Use token classes (bg-surface, text-muted, border-line, ring-ring, shadow-lift, rounded-md); never raw hex.
- Variants use class-variance-authority. Export `xVariants` to style other elements (e.g. a Link as a button).
- Stateful components support controlled and uncontrolled use (value/defaultValue).
- Files without "use client" are server-safe; import icons from @phosphor-icons/react/dist/ssr there.

## Components

### navigation

#### accordion
Expandable sections with smooth height animation. Single or multiple open.
- file: src/components/ui/accordion.tsx
- exports: Accordion
- client component
- peers: @phosphor-icons/react
- <Accordion>
  - items: { id: string; title: string; content: ReactNode; }[] — The items to render.
  - type?: "single" | "multiple" = "single" — Whether one item or several can be open at once.
  - defaultOpen?: string[] — Initial open state when uncontrolled.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

#### breadcrumb
Path trail showing the current location in a hierarchy.
- file: src/components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx
- exports: Breadcrumb
- server-safe
- peers: @phosphor-icons/react
- <Breadcrumb>
  - items: { label: string; href?: string | undefined; }[] — The items to render.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

#### floating-nav
A pill-shaped navigation bar with a highlight that glides between items and settles on the current one.
- file: src/components/ui/floating-nav.tsx
- exports: FloatingNav
- client component
- <FloatingNav> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)
  - items: FloatingNavItem[] — The items to render.
  - value?: string — Controlled active item.
  - defaultValue?: string — Initial value when uncontrolled.
  - onChange?: ((value: string) => void) — Called when the value changes.
  - hideOnScroll?: boolean = false — Slide out of view while scrolling down.

#### pagination
Page navigator with collapsing ellipses.
- file: src/components/ui/pagination.tsx
- exports: Pagination
- client component
- peers: @phosphor-icons/react
- <Pagination>
  - page: number — Current page, 1-based.
  - totalPages: number — Total number of pages.
  - onPageChange: (page: number) => void — Called with the new page number.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

  - onChange: (value: T) => void — Called when the value changes.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

#### sidebar
An app sidebar that collapses to an icon rail: grouped links, nested menus and a marker that glides to the active page.
- file: src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx
- exports: Sidebar
- client component
- <Sidebar> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)
  - sections: SidebarSection[]
  - value?: string — Controlled active page.
  - defaultValue?: string — Initial value when uncontrolled.
  - onChange?: ((value: string) => void) — Called when the value changes.
  - collapsed?: boolean — Controlled collapsed state.
  - defaultCollapsed?: boolean = false
  - onCollapsedChange?: ((collapsed: boolean) => void)
  - header?: ReactNode — Sits at the top, beside the collapse button.
  - footer?: ReactNode — Sits at the bottom.

#### stepper
Progress through numbered steps. Circles pop and the connector fills as `current` advances.
- file: src/components/ui/stepper.tsx
- exports: Stepper
- server-safe
- peers: @phosphor-icons/react
- <Stepper>
  - steps: { label: string; description?: string | undefined; }[] — Array of { label, description? }.
  - current: number — Zero-based index of the active step.
  - orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical" = "vertical" — Layout direction.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

#### table-of-contents
A contents list that follows the page: the current section is marked, and a line beside it fills as you read.
- file: src/components/ui/table-of-contents.tsx
- exports: TableOfContents
- client component
- <TableOfContents> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)
  - items: TocItem[] — Headings to list, by element id. `depth` indents them.
  - title?: string = "On this page" — Small label above the list. Pass an empty string to hide it.
  - offset?: number = 96 — How far from the top of the view a heading counts as current, in px.
  - scrollRoot?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null> — A scrolling element to watch instead of the window.

#### tabs
Tabs with arrow-key navigation, in pill or underline style.
- file: src/components/ui/tabs.tsx
- exports: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent
- client component
- <Tabs>
  - defaultValue: string — Initial value when uncontrolled.
  - children: ReactNode — Content rendered inside the component.
  - value?: string — Controlled value.
  - onValueChange?: ((v: string) => void) — Called with the new value.
  - variant?: "pill" | "line" = "pill" — Visual style.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.
- <TabsList> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
- <TabsTrigger> (also accepts ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>)
  - value: string | (readonly string[] & string) — Controlled value.
- <TabsContent> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
  - value: string — Controlled value.

  - items: { title: string; time: string; body?: string | undefined; }[] — The items to render.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

### craft

#### ai-orb

- file: src/components/ui/ai-orb.tsx
- exports: AiOrb
- client component
- <AiOrb>
  - state?: OrbState = "idle" — What the assistant is doing. Changes are eased, never snapped.
  - level?: number = 0 — Live loudness from 0 to 1 (microphone or voice output). It swells the orb.
  - size?: number = 168 — Diameter of the sphere in px.
  - label?: string — Accessible description. Defaults to the state.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

- file: src/components/ui/aura-border.tsx
- exports: AuraBorder
- client component
- <AuraBorder> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)

  - radius?: number = 20 — Corner radius of the content, in px. The glow follows it.
  - thickness?: number = 2 — Width of the crisp ring, in px.
  - glow?: number = 22 — How far the soft halo spreads, in px.
  - speed?: number = 0.12 — Laps per second around the edge.
  - colors?: string[] = AURORA — CSS colours, swept around the edge in order.

#### dither-image
A photograph reduced to two colours with ordered dithering, which a lens of full colour dissolves through.
- file: src/components/ui/dither-image.tsx
- exports: DitherImage
- client component
- <DitherImage> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
  - src: string — Image address. A data URI or a same-origin or CORS-enabled URL.
  - alt: string — Describes the picture for assistive tech.
  - pixel?: number = 3 — Size of one dither cell, in CSS px. Bigger is chunkier.
  - radius?: number = 110 — Radius of the colour lens, in px.
  - contrast?: number = 1.15 — Stretch the tones before dithering. Above 1 is punchier.
  - fg?: string — Dark colour of the dither. Defaults to the ink token.
  - bg?: string — Light colour of the dither. Defaults to the canvas token.
  - idle?: boolean = true — Let the lens wander on its own while the pointer is away.

  - onConfirm?: (() => void) — Called once the hold completes.

  - resetMs?: number = 2200 — After this many ms the button returns to its start state. 0 keeps it confirmed.
  - tone?: "danger" | "ink" = "ink" — `danger` fills with red for destructive actions.

#### keycap
A keyboard key with real travel: it dips under your finger, springs back, and can click.
- file: src/components/ui/keycap.tsx
- exports: Keycap
- client component
- peers: class-variance-authority
- <Keycap> (also accepts ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>)
  - children: ReactNode — The label on the cap.
  - size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md" — Size preset.
  - legend?: ReactNode — A small label in the corner, such as a modifier symbol.
  - shortcut?: string — Press this key combination to press the cap, for example `k`, `mod+k` or `shift+enter`.
  - sound?: boolean = false — Play a small click. Off unless you ask for it.
  - onPress?: (() => void) — Called on every press, whether it came from a pointer, the keyboard or the shortcut.

#### knob
A rotary dial with ticks: drag it up and down, scroll over it, use the arrow keys, double-click to reset.
- file: src/components/ui/knob.tsx
- exports: Knob
- client component
- <Knob> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
  - value?: number — Controlled value.
  - defaultValue?: number = 50 — Initial value when uncontrolled. Double-click returns to it.
  - onValueChange?: ((value: number) => void) — Called with the new value.
  - min?: number = 0 — Lower bound.
  - max?: number = 100 — Upper bound.
  - step?: number = 1 — Smallest change. Values snap to it.
  - size?: number = 132 — Diameter in px.
  - ticks?: number = 28 — How many tick marks to draw around the dial.
  - label?: string — Shown under the dial, and used as its accessible name.
  - format?: ((value: number) => string) = (v) => String(Math.round(v)) — Turns the value into the text shown in the middle.

#### liquid-glass

- file: src/components/ui/liquid-glass.tsx
- exports: LiquidGlass
- client component
- <LiquidGlass> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
  - radius?: number = 28 — Corner radius in px. Use a large value for a pill.
  - blur?: number = 1 — Blur behind the glass in px. Keep it low so the refraction stays readable.
  - refraction?: number = 60 — How far the rim bends the backdrop, in px. 0 turns refraction off.
  - aberration?: number = 8 — Colour fringing at the rim, in px of channel offset.
  - saturation?: number = 1.5 — Backdrop saturation multiplier.
  - interactive?: boolean = true — Let the highlight and rim light follow the pointer.

  - format?: NumberFormatOptions — `Intl.NumberFormat` options, for example `{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }`.
  - duration?: number = 1100 — Roll time in ms. Wheels to the left start a little later.

  - center?: ReactNode — Content for the center of the ring.

  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

#### split-flap
A mechanical departures board: every character is a pair of flaps that turn over through the alphabet.
- file: src/components/ui/split-flap.tsx
- exports: SplitFlap
- client component
- <SplitFlap> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
  - value: string — What to show. Letters are upper-cased; anything not in `charset` becomes a blank.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.
  - length?: number — Number of cells. The value is padded with blanks, or cut, to fit. Defaults to its length.
  - charset?: string = CHARS — The characters a flap can show, in the order it cycles through them. Keep the blank first.
  - size?: number = 56 — Height of one cell, in px. Everything else scales from it.
  - tone?: "ink" | "amber" | "paper" = "ink" — `ink` is charcoal and warm white, `amber` is the classic orange on black, `paper` is white.
  - stagger?: number = 40 — Delay between one cell starting and the next, in ms.
  - sound?: boolean = false — Click as the flaps land. Browsers wait for a first click or tap before they allow sound.

  - items?: SortableItem[] — Controlled items, in order.
  - defaultItems?: SortableItem[] = [] — Initial items when uncontrolled.
  - onItemsChange?: ((items: SortableItem[]) => void) — Called with the new order after a drop or a keyboard move.
  - handle?: boolean = true — Drag only by the grip. Turn off to drag from anywhere on the row (not for rows with their own controls).
  - itemClassName?: string — Classes for every row.

#### sparkline
A tiny trend line for dropping into a table cell or a stat: smooth, gradient-filled, with a live end point.
- file: src/components/ui/sparkline.tsx
- exports: Sparkline
- client component
- <Sparkline> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
  - data: number[]
  - color?: string — Line colour. By default it follows the trend: green up, red down, ink flat.
  - format?: ((n: number) => string) = (n: number) => String(n) — How a value is written in the hover bubble.
  - area?: boolean = true — Fill under the line.

  - label?: string — Text above the slider.
  - disabled?: boolean — Prevents interaction and dims the control.
  - className?: string — Extra classes, merged with the component's own.

#### status-button

- file: src/components/ui/status-button.tsx
- exports: StatusButton
- client component
- peers: class-variance-authority
- also imports: button
- <StatusButton> (also accepts ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>)
  - children?: ReactNode = "Save changes" — The label when idle.
  - variant?: "primary" | "accent" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "soft" | "danger" — Visual style.
  - size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | "icon-sm" — Size preset.
  - status?: ButtonStatus — Controlled state. Leave it out and the button runs itself from `onClick`.
  - onClick?: (() => void | Promise<unknown>) — May return a promise: pending is loading, resolved is success, rejected is error.
  - loadingLabel?: ReactNode = "Saving"
  - successLabel?: ReactNode = "Saved"
  - errorLabel?: ReactNode = "Try again"
  - resetAfter?: number = 2000 — Milliseconds before success or error returns to idle. 0 keeps it.

- file: src/components/ui/neon-text.tsx
- exports: NeonText
- client component
- <NeonText> (also accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>)
  - children: string — The text. Keep it a plain string.
  - color?: string = "#ff3d9a" — Colour of the gas. The core of the tube is a paler tint of it.
  - flicker?: boolean = true — Let a random letter stutter now and then.
  - halo?: boolean = true — Spill a soft glow behind the letters.
